page_trace.ai_warn: Many researchers are trying AI in their work, and guidance on reporting it in research is still forming, so check what your university and your journals say now. AI makes mistakes, invents facts and can lend false confidence to a judgment. With these features on, the passages and sources you ask about are sent to the AI provider you choose. These features are experimental and not for a manuscript's real checking. The advice is to keep them off unless you are researching AI in scholarly writing. They are there to suggest and to help you think, never to judge a claim for you.
